state_machine.exhaustiveness_rule: every geometry-ready window has exactly one primary state; diagnostics are subordinate and may overlap
state_machine.STAGNANT: geometry ready and movement below threshold
state_machine.CRYSTALLIZED: active, coherent, recurrent and contracting predicate sustained for at least one tau
state_machine.CRYSTALLIZING: active, coherent, recurrent and contracting predicate sustained for less than one tau
state_machine.RECURRENT: active, coherent and recurrent without the crystallizing predicate
state_machine.VIABLE: residual active state; viability_confirmed is true only when transport coherence meets threshold

diagnostic_semantics.IMITATIVE_ECHO: active recurrence without sufficient local transport coherence
diagnostic_semantics.LOCAL_TRANSPORT_DISCONTINUITY: single-window transport prediction below threshold; not global coherence loss
diagnostic_semantics.PERSISTENT_TRANSPORT_DISRUPTION: local transport discontinuity sustained for at least one tau
diagnostic_semantics.INSUFFICIENT_GEOMETRY: window lacks the causal geometric support required for a primary state

claim_boundary: V7 is an offline state/reporting correction over saved v6 numeric trajectories.
No model is called and no numeric v6 channel is refit.
External protocol completion is joined only after blind structural projection.
Fixed horizons include only sessions that reached the specified number of windows.
